description: Remove one path ignore from a website. Tracker issues it alone was holding go back from ignored to open; the findings appear again in the next audit's report and score. Needs the audits:write scope and an owner or admin role.

path_glob.description: The path glob of the ignore, as list_path_ignores shows.

rule.description: The rule id of the ignore, as list_path_ignores shows.

name: remove_path_ignore
title: Remove a path ignore
